notes: Mirage v3.0 — the revamp. Light mode (warm paper, not inverted dark). New home screen: the bottom sheet is gone and the map gets its space back. Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Walk/Drive here now works from your real location after a confirmation. Map style swatches, a full-screen Places screen, km/h ↔ mph in Settings, and you can change speed while moving. Settings rebuilt. Considerably faster with a spoof running. Update from Settings → Updates.
